When you choose not to equip armor, you have a base {{term:armor-score|Armor Score}} of 3 + your {{term:strength|Strength}} and use the following as your base {{term:damage-thresholds|damage thresholds}}:

- **_Tier 1_**: 9/19
- **_Tier 2_**: 11/24
- **_Tier 3_**: 13/31
- **_Tier 4_**: 15/38

name: Forceful Push
text:
Make an attack with your primary weapon against a target within {{term:melee|Melee range}}. On a success, you deal damage and knock them back to {{term:close|Close range}}. On a success with {{term:hope|Hope}}, add a **d6** to your damage roll.

Additionally, you can **spend a {{term:hope|Hope}}** to make them {{term:temporary|temporarily}} _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_.

name: I Am Your Shield
text: When an ally within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} would take damage, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to stand in the way and make yourself the target of the attack instead. When you take damage from this attack, you can mark any number of {{term:armor-slot|Armor Slots}}.

name: Body Basher
text: You use the full force of your body in a fight. On a successful attack using a weapon with a {{term:melee|Melee range}}, gain a bonus to your damage roll equal to your {{term:strength|Strength}}.

name: Bold Presence
text:
When you make a {{term:presence|Presence}} Roll, you can **spend a {{term:hope|Hope}}** to add your {{term:strength|Strength}} to the roll.

Additionally, once per rest when you would gain a condition, you can describe how your bold presence aids you in the situation and avoid gaining the condition.

name: Critical Inspiration
text: Once per rest, when you critically succeed on an attack, all allies within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} can clear a {{term:stress|Stress}} or gain a {{term:hope|Hope}}.

name: Lean on Me
text: Once per {{term:long-rest|long rest}}, when you console or inspire an ally who failed an {{term:action-roll|action roll}}, you can both clear 2 {{term:stress|Stress}}.

name: Goad Them on
text: Describe how you taunt a target within {{term:close|Close range}}, then make a **{{term:presence|Presence}} Roll** against them. On a success, the target must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}, and the next time the GM spotlights them, they must target you with an attack, which they make with {{term:disadvantage|disadvantage}}.

name: Support Tank
text: When an ally within {{term:close|Close range}} fails a roll, you can **spend 2** **{{term:hope|Hope}}** to allow them to reroll either their {{term:hope|Hope}} or {{term:duality-dice|Fear Die}}.

name: Armorer
text:
While you’re wearing armor, gain a +1 bonus to your {{term:armor-score|Armor Score}}.

During a rest, when you choose to repair your armor as a {{term:downtime|downtime move}}, your allies also clear an {{term:armor-slot|Armor Slot}}.

name: Rousing Strike
text: Once per rest, when you critically succeed on an attack, you and all allies who can see or hear you can clear a {{term:hit-points|Hit Point}} or **1d4** {{term:stress|Stress}}.

name: Inevitable
text: When you fail an {{term:action-roll|action roll}}, your next {{term:action-roll|action roll}} has {{term:advantage|advantage}}.

name: Rise Up
text:
Gain a bonus to your {{term:damage-thresholds|Severe threshold}} equal to your {{term:proficiency|Proficiency}}.

When you mark 1 or more {{term:hit-points|Hit Points}} from an attack, clear a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

name: Shrug It Off
text: When you would take damage, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to reduce the severity of the damage by one threshold. When you do, roll a **d6**. On a result of 3 or lower, place this card in your {{term:vault|vault}}.

name: Valor-Touched
Full Surge
text: Once per {{term:long-rest|long rest}}, **mark 3 {{term:stress|Stress}}** to push your body to its limits. Gain a +2 bonus to all of your character traits until your next rest.

name: Ground Pound
text: **Spend 2 {{term:hope|Hope}}** to strike the ground where you stand and make a **{{term:strength|Strength}} Roll** against all targets within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}. Targets you succeed against are thrown back to {{term:far|Far range}} and must make a {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} (17). Targets who fail take **4d10+8** damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

name: Hold the Line
text:
Describe the defensive stance you take and **spend a {{term:hope|Hope}}**. If an adversary moves within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}, they’re pulled into {{term:melee|Melee range}} and _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_.

This condition lasts until you move or fail a roll with {{term:fear|Fear}}, or the GM spends 2 {{term:fear|Fear}} on their turn to clear it.

name: Lead by Example
text: When you deal damage to an adversary, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** and describe how you encourage your allies. The next PC to make an attack against that adversary can clear a {{term:stress|Stress}} or gain a {{term:hope|Hope}}.

name: Unbreakable
text: When you mark your last {{term:hit-points|Hit Point}}, instead of making a {{term:death-move|death move}}, you can roll a **d6** and clear a number of {{term:hit-points|Hit Points}} equal to the result. Then place this card in your {{term:vault|vault}}.

name: Unyielding Armor
text: When you would mark an {{term:armor-slot|Armor Slot}}, roll a number of **d6s** equal to your {{term:proficiency|Proficiency}}. If any roll a 6, reduce the severity by one threshold without marking an {{term:armor-slot|Armor Slot}}.
